Audinate Dante AVIO Install sales guide (downloaded, read as text on 2026-11-12): 2-channel analog input adapter and 2-channel analog output adapter (AVIO-A-2IN-EB, AVIO-A-2OUT-EB), both 150.7 x 53.8 x 38.1 mm and 145 g, each a 6-pin Euroblock terminal (3.5 mm pitch) and a Dante network connector, powered by Class 1 802.3af PoE (no mains inlet). The plan row covers the family; this model is the 2-CHANNEL ANALOG INPUT adapter (one balanced 2-channel Euroblock input to Dante): the Euroblock is modelled as one port (two channels on one 6-pin block), the network port as RJ45 Dante primary. The output adapter is a separate SKU of the same size and is not modelled.
Port positions are GUESSES (no panel drawing). build: a moulded box, exact bounding box; the rounding is an ESTIMATE. build.projection: our own generic artwork; no photo, no logo, no lettering.
